params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
$wt=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'agent-worktrees\complete-workflows-final-20260929-chatgpt-a2'
$localBranch='local/complete-workflows-final-20260929-a2'
git -C $repo fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
git -C $repo worktree prune | Out-Null
if(Test-Path $wt){ git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null | Out-Null; if(Test-Path $wt){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $wt -Recurse -Force} }
git -C $repo show-ref --verify --quiet ("refs/heads/"+$localBranch)
if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){ git -C $repo branch -D $localBranch | Out-Null }
git -C $repo worktree add -b $localBranch $wt origin/main | Out-Null
$env:OPENCODE_CONFIG='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\opencode-fallback.json'
$oc='C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-tools\opencode\package\bin\opencode.exe'
Push-Location $wt
try {
  $prompt=@'
You are the final integration engineer for fengie/mhw-mods. This is the last ordinary remote branch preventing branch-zero.

Read AGENTS.md and all current repository instructions first. Reconstruct current origin/main before editing. Historical source branch: origin/codex/complete-mod-workflows at cae2407e5245ab27339967f2b5522a37c1e60152; primary product implementation commit: 02fa1dd5c3e98d319067043598bfdfd32617e65f.

DO NOT merge/replay that branch wholesale. Its old continuity/version/verification/CI history is stale. Selectively port only useful product code, tests, and durable docs onto this fresh current-main worktree, preserving every newer behavior/invariant on main.

Reconcile genuinely missing/still-useful capabilities where compatible with current architecture:
- FOMOD installer service + chooser UI, including safe archive-import choice flow and remembered selections.
- Smart Inbox FOMOD detection while preserving current SafeRecursiveTraversal and modern ExtractSafelyAsync containment APIs; original source must stay untouched for interactive import.
- Rules editor, update migration, game adapter contract/SDK, workflow analysis, workflow UI, WORKFLOWS/GAME-ADAPTER-SDK docs.
- Richer collection recipe format/import/preview behavior and tests/self-test.
- Crash bisector interaction/ddmin improvements while preserving current baseline/control/full-suspect validation, cancellation correctness, cleanup, and single-culprit truthfulness.
- Still-relevant conflict/planner/deployment/storage changes and focused workflow tests; do not regress containment, launch atomicity, profile identity, updater, or UI behavior.

Keep current main versions of version identity/CHANGELOG, _AGENT_CONTEXT continuity/checkpoint files, .verification cache, and current CI unless a narrowly necessary current-main-compatible edit is required. Do not import historical evidence dumps merely to preserve branch history.

Resolve product conflicts semantically. Prefer adding missing new files then adapt them to current APIs. Use the old commit as a reference, not authority.

Verification before committing:
1. git diff --check
2. dotnet build MhwModManager.sln -c Release -m:1 -warnaserror (if solution name differs, discover the current solution and build the equivalent)
3. relevant Core/Automation/Storage/Integration test projects produced by the Release build, especially workflow/FOMOD/recipe/crash/deployment tests
4. self-test if applicable.
Fix failures caused by this port. Do not weaken tests.

Commit one coherent reconciliation commit locally. DO NOT push. End by printing BASE origin/main SHA, FINAL HEAD SHA, files changed, exact verification commands/results, and limitations.
'@
  & $oc run --standalone --auto --model 'ollama/qwen2.5-coder:7b' --format json $prompt
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw ('LOCAL_AGENT_FAILED '+$LASTEXITCODE) }
  Write-Output '=== FINAL_STATUS ==='
  git status --short
  Write-Output ('BASE='+(git merge-base HEAD origin/main).Trim())
  Write-Output ('HEAD='+(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim())
  git log -3 --oneline
  git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
} finally { Pop-Location }
